# Risheek Nawka

> Risheek Nawka is a 19-year-old creative technologist applying to the a16z Horowitz Academy founding class. Tagline: "I build things where art and technology meet." Key facts: Founder, Summer; Consulted for Adobe; 7 creative-tech projects shipped; Gap year, building full-time.

This site is an interactive portfolio. The click-through "story" is animated and has little readable text; every fact is also available as plain text below.
